question: Which five cities in Bihar hosted the Khelo India Youth Games 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Khelo India Youth Games:**

__
 
• 7th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) was held in Bihar from May 4 to May 15, 2025 
 
• **Mascot: **Gajasimha
 
• **The games were conducted across five cities in Bihar:**
 
 
• Patna
 
• Rajgir
 
• Gaya
 
• Bhagalpur
 
• Begusarai
 
 
 
• While, the three major events – gymnastics, shooting and cycling – were held in New Delhi. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bihar's Total Medals:**

 
 
• Gold: 7
 
• Silver: 11
 
• Bronze: 18
 
• Total: 36
 
 
 
• This was Bihar’s best-ever performance, jumping from 24th to 15th place in the national ranking
 
• **Notable Medal-Winning Athletes from Bihar:**
 
 
• **Gold Medalists:**
 
 
• **Alka Singh **– Won girls’ shot put gold with a **14.73 m throw at Patliputra Sports Complex**, marking Bihar’s first gold in athletics at the Games
 
• **Khushi Yadav –** Clinched girls’** 2000 m steeplechase gold in 9:52.10**, the second gold in athletics for Bihar
 
• **Priya Prerna & Mahika Kumari **– Each secured gold in Thang‑Ta (Manipuri martial art) events, with Bihar also adding three bronze medals in Thang‑Ta
 
• **Bihar's rugby teams** achieved a historic double gold, with the girls winning 22-0 and the boys winning 14-12.
